description: Defines the EnvelopeADSR class, a simple attack-decay-sustain-release envelope generator for synthesizers, implementing linear ramps and states for different envelope phases.

classes.name: EnvelopeADSR
classes.description: A Java class implementing an ADSR envelope with linear ramps for audio synthesis.

methods.name: EnvelopeADSR
methods.description: Constructor initializing default envelope times and levels.

methods.name: setAttackTime
methods.description: Sets the attack phase duration and calculates attack rate.

methods.name: setDecayTime
methods.description: Sets the decay phase duration and calculates decay rate.

methods.name: setReleaseTime
methods.description: Sets the release phase duration and calculates release rate.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Starts the attack phase of the envelope.

methods.name: off
methods.description: Starts the release phase of the envelope.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Advances the envelope state and returns the current envelope level.

methods.name: isDone
methods.description: Checks if the envelope has finished its release phase.
